mapper.update: UPDATE user_preference SET revision=#{value.revision},theme=#{value.theme},font_size=#{value.fontSize}, content_width=#{value.contentWidth},motion=#{value.motion},time_zone=#{value.timeZone}, save_recovery_notice=#{value.saveRecoveryNotice},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND revision=#{expected} AND revision < 9007199254740991
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND kind='NOTE') AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND kind='CONCEPT') AS concepts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_version WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS knowledge_versions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_board WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS boards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preparation_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS preparation_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS questions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_session WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS training_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_answer WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS submitted_answers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_card WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS memory_cards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_attachment WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS attachments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner}) AS ai_tasks, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(reserved_bytes) FROM material_upload WHERE owner_id=#{owner}),0) +COALESCE((SELECT SUM(reserved_bytes) FROM material_parse_run WHERE owner_id=#{owner}),0) AS material_reserved_bytes
